msg_help.message: $TITLE$ shortcuts: $P$+L listen/stop. $P$+S submit. $P$+X stop speaking. $P$+C copy. $P$+R clear. $P$+H help. $P$+M minimize/show. $P$+D diagnose. $P$+F focus input. $P$+G toggle debug lines. $P$+E errors-only view. $P$+V verbose console logging. Press Escape to stop listening/speaking.

opt_instructions.message: Welcome to Convox login setup. Here are your voice commands. Say: set username, then your username or EUID. Say: set password, then your password. Say: save, to store your credentials. Say: clear, to delete saved credentials. Say: what did you save, to confirm what is stored. Say: repeat, to hear these instructions again.

opt_username_set.message: Username set to $VALUE$. Say set password, then your password, or say save if you're done.

opt_password_set.message: Password set. Say save to confirm, or set username if you haven't done that yet.

opt_nothing_to_save.message: Nothing to save yet. Say set username, then your username, and set password, then your password.

opt_saved_voice.message: Saved. Username is $USER$. Password is $PW$. You can now close this page and say log in on the Canvas login page.

opt_cleared_voice.message: Credentials cleared. Say set username to start over.

opt_unrecognized.message: I didn't catch that. Say repeat to hear the available commands.

opt_status_enter.message: Please enter a username or password.

opt_prompt_username.message: No saved credentials were found. Please type or say your username or EUID now.

opt_prompt_password.message: Got it. Now type or say your password.

opt_setup_complete.message: Setup complete. Username is $USER$ and password is $PW$. You can close this page and say log in again.

opt_field_retry.message: I didn't catch that. Please say your $FIELD$.
